title: Surveying and sketching in Porirua Bush in the 1840s
credit: Samuel Charles Brees (1810–1865); Alexander Turnbull Library historical image
altText: Historical engraved scene showing nineteenth-century surveyors, a theodolite, sketchbook and a Wellington-area riverscape.
caption: Samuel Charles Brees with a theodolite, sketchbook and fellow surveyors in Porirua Bush, with a vignette of the Hutt River below.
context: The published illustration shows the observations and field measurements that preceded electronic survey calculation. It is historical surveying, not digital computation.
